ayahs.en: By those [angels] who extract with violence
ayahs.e2: By those ˹angels˺ stripping out ˹evil souls˺ harshly

ayahs.en: And [by] those who remove with ease
ayahs.e2: and those pulling out ˹good souls˺ gently

ayahs.en: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
ayahs.e2: and those gliding ˹through heavens˺ swiftly

ayahs.en: And those who race each other in a race
ayahs.e2: and those taking the lead vigorously

ayahs.en: And those who arrange [each] matter
ayahs.e2: and those conducting affairs ˹obediently˺

ayahs.en: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation]
ayahs.e2: ˹Consider˺ the Day ˹when˺ the quaking Blast will come to pass

ayahs.en: There will follow it the subsequent [one]
ayahs.e2: followed by a second Blast

ayahs.en: Hearts, that Day, will tremble
ayahs.e2: ˹The deniers’˺ hearts on that Day will be trembling ˹in horror˺

ayahs.en: Their eyes humbled
ayahs.e2: with their eyes downcast

ayahs.en: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]
ayahs.e2: ˹But now˺ they ask ˹mockingly˺, “Will we really be restored to our former state
ayahs.tr: Ya qoo loona a-inna lamar doo doona fil haafirah

ayahs.en: Even if we should be decayed bones
ayahs.e2: even after we have been reduced to decayed bones?”

ayahs.en: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return
ayahs.e2: Adding, “Then such a return would be a ˹total˺ loss ˹for us˺!”

ayahs.en: Indeed, it will be but one shout
ayahs.e2: But indeed, it will take only one ˹mighty˺ Blast

ayahs.en: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface
ayahs.e2: and at once they will be above ground

ayahs.en: Has there reached you the story of Moses
ayahs.e2: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayahs.en: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa
ayahs.e2: His Lord called him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa
ayahs.tr: Iz nadaahu rabbuhu bil waadil-muqad dasi tuwa

ayahs.en: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed
ayahs.e2: ˹commanding,˺ “Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺

ayahs.ar: فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.en: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
ayahs.e2: And say, ‘Would you ˹be willing to˺ purify yourself

ayahs.en: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]
ayahs.e2: and let me guide you to your Lord so that you will be in awe ˹of Him˺?’”
ayahs.tr: Wa ahdi yaka ila rabbika fatakh sha

ayahs.en: And he showed him the greatest sign
ayahs.e2: Then Moses showed him the great sign

ayahs.en: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed
ayahs.e2: but he denied and disobeyed ˹Allah˺

ayahs.en: Then he turned his back, striving
ayahs.e2: then turned his back, striving ˹against the truth˺

ayahs.en: And he gathered [his people] and called out
ayahs.e2: Then he summoned ˹his people˺ and called out

ayahs.en: And said, "I am your most exalted lord
ayahs.e2: saying, “I am your lord, the most high!”

ayahs.en: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]
ayahs.e2: So Allah overtook him, making him an example in this life and the next
ayahs.tr: Fa-akha zahul laahu nakalal aakhirati wal-oola

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةࣰ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah]
ayahs.e2: Surely in this is a lesson for whoever stands in awe of ˹Allah˺

ayahs.ar: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.en: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it
ayahs.e2: Which is harder to create: you or the sky? He built it
ayahs.tr: A-antum a shaddu khalqan amis samaa-u banaaha

ayahs.en: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it
ayahs.e2: raising it high and forming it flawlessly

ayahs.en: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness
ayahs.e2: He dimmed its night, and brought forth its daylight
ayahs.tr: Wa aghtasha lailaha wa akhraja duhaaha

ayahs.en: And after that He spread the earth
ayahs.e2: As for the earth, He spread it out as well

ayahs.en: He extracted from it its water and its pasture
ayahs.e2: bringing forth its water and pastures

ayahs.en: And the mountains He set firmly
ayahs.e2: and setting the mountains firmly ˹upon it˺—

ayahs.en: As provision for you and your grazing livestock
ayahs.e2: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals

ayahs.en: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity
ayahs.e2: But, when the Supreme Disaster comes to pass—

ayahs.en: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove
ayahs.e2: the Day every person will remember all ˹their˺ striving
ayahs.tr: Yauma Yata zakkarul insaanu ma sa'aa

ayahs.en: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see
ayahs.e2: and the Hellfire will be displayed for all to see—

ayahs.en: So as for he who transgressed
ayahs.e2: then as for those who transgressed

ayahs.en: And preferred the life of the world
ayahs.e2: and preferred the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world

ayahs.en: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge
ayahs.e2: the Hellfire will certainly be ˹their˺ home

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ
ayahs.en: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination
ayahs.e2: And as for those who were in awe of standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from ˹evil˺ desires
ayahs.tr: Wa ammaa man khaafa maqaama Rabbihee wa nahan nafsa 'anil hawaa

ayahs.en: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge
ayahs.e2: Paradise will certainly be ˹their˺ home

ayahs.en: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival
ayahs.e2: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺ regarding the Hour, “When will it be?”

ayahs.en: In what [position] are you that you should mention it
ayahs.e2: But it is not for you to tell its time

ayahs.en: To your Lord is its finality
ayahs.e2: That knowledge rests with your Lord ˹alone˺

ayahs.en: You are only a warner for those who fear it
ayahs.e2: Your duty is only to warn whoever is in awe of it

ayahs.ar: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.en: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof
ayahs.e2: On the Day they see it, it will be as if they had stayed ˹in the world˺ no more than one evening or its morning
ayahs.tr: Ka annahum Yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasooo illaa 'ashiyyatan aw duhaahaa
